meta.title: An RFQ stage that needs creation approval is held as "requested" and its closing time is pushed out
gaps: Cannot assert that exactly one pending approval request exists or that its title is Trade Creation Requested because the approvals response shape is not sampled.
Cannot assert misc.approver_identifiers because it is not a read-back field.
Cannot calculate or assert that ending_at equals the scheduled end plus the sum of every approval step's expires_in; only that the returned closing time is a JSON number.

it depends on a company setting this run does not change (Company approval flow version v2 with an active create-trade (Trade Creation) approval flow whose trigger matches the RFQ stage) — a failure is reported as couldn't tell, not as a bug

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with one line item and an RFQ (pricing) round attached, not published.
steps: As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that Data check: “current status” equals requested; Schema check: “ending at” is a number.
As the buyer, read the trade get approvals request and check that Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Data check: “current status” equals requested; Schema check: “ending at” is a number; Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
